# GroupDocs.Parser documentation

> On-premise SDK docs for extracting text, formatted text, tables, images, metadata, hyperlinks and barcodes from PDF, Microsoft Office, OpenDocument, email, eBook, archive and image files.
> Platforms: net | java | python-net | nodejs-java | mcp
> .NET TFMs: net462, netstandard2.1, net6.0, net8.0, net10.0

## Hubs

- https://docs.groupdocs.com/parser/net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/parser/java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/parser/python-net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/parser/nodejs-java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/parser/mcp/
